# Definition 
**Endometriosis** is growth of endometrial glands and stroma outside the uterus. 

# Risk Factors
- Nulliparity
- Early Menarche 
- Family History

# Presentation 
Dysmenorrhea, Dyspareunia, Dyschezia, due to endometrial infiltration in the associated organs.

# Diagnosis 
TVUS / Laparoscopy

# Treatment 
- 1st: Combined OCPs + NSAIDs
	- can add leuprolide (GnRH agonist) to suppress endometrial growth
- 2nd: Laparoscopic excision/ablation
- 3rd: Hysterectomy if other options refractory or no fertility desired
